sentences.text: This is second application filed under section 439 of Cr.P.C in crime no.556/2023 under section 452, 354(A), 354(B), 376, 511 of IPC and 7/8, 18 of POCSO Act registered at police station YD Nagar District Mandsaur.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The first application was dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the statement of mother and brother of the prosecutrix have been recorded and they have not supported the prosecution case.
The prosecutrix has been examined and she has supported the prosecution case.
As per scholar register, she is only 13 years old.
There is no reason to disbelieve the testimony of the prosecutrix.
Hence, no case is made out for grant of bail.
However, it is observed that the trial court shall make all endevours to expedite the trial.
With the aforesaid, the present application stands dismissed.
